def weighted_duration(base, product, filter_, groupby):
    durations     = data(base + '.time.ns.p75', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_product', product),  rollup='average').mean(by=groupby)

    counts     = data(base + '.count', filter=filter_ and filter('sf_product', product),  rollup='sum').sum(by=groupby)

    weight     = (durations * counts).sum(over='1m')


    return (weight / (counts.sum(over='1m') * 1000000000))
